description: Tile ids of the placeholder tilesets (DESIGN.md 2.3). Index = Tiled tile id; gid = id + the tileset's firstgid. src/systems/placeholderArt.ts paints one tile per name, in this order; scripts/generate-maps.mjs places them by name. Ids 0-7 are the session 1 set (the test map uses them): append, never reorder.
